subject: Reconciling PO discount waterfall and partner net for BrightLayer
messages:
From: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@brightlayer.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@brightlayer.com
Date: 2026-05-14T10:03:00-04:00
Subject: BrightLayer PO: reconciliation of list-price vs private-offer net

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for getting the PO out quickly. Our finance team is running final checks and we need a short reconciliation showing how the private-offer discount maps back to the marketplace list price and the resulting partner net / reseller passback. Specifically we need: 

- SKU mapping (marketplace SKU -> private offer SKU) and per-SKU list price used for the PO
- The exact discount calculation applied (list price, partner discount, any platform credits)
- The net amount the reseller will invoice/receive (we call this "partner net") and whether any tax/withholding is being withheld at source

We also have an auditor asking for a short spreadsheet and an attestation that the passback matches the private-offer breakdown. Can you send us the waterfall and the invoice flow (who the final payee should be)?

Attachments: I attached the PO acknowledgement our procurement team has (BL_PO_1223_summary.pdf).

We'd like to close this by Tue 5/19 — can you confirm timeline?

Best,
Anita Sharma
Head of Procurement, BrightLayer
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer PO: reconciliation of list-price vs private-offer net

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the PO summary. Looping Ben (channel ops) and Irene (channel finance) to run the margin workback and confirm the invoice flow.

Quick answers up-front:
- We can provide a per-SKU waterfall (list price -> private-offer price -> partner net) and a signed cover sheet for your auditor.
- We’ll call out any platform credits or promotional offsets explicitly so they reconcile line-by-line.
- For invoice/payee: we support reseller-as-payee flows; we just need the reseller tax ID and the billing instructions in the PO to match.

Next steps proposed:
1) Ben to do an initial pass at the channel margin waterfall and attach a workbook (expected EOD 5/15 PT).
2) Irene to confirm tax/withholding treatment and whether any escrow/holdbacks apply for the reseller (EOD 5/15 PT).
3) I’ll consolidate and send a single PDF attestation + spreadsheet for your records (target 5/16 PT).

If that timeline works, Ben — can you start the workback using the PO file attached by Anita? Also requesting the reseller name/tax ID if BrightLayer wants the reseller to be payee.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer PO: reconciliation of list-price vs private-offer net

On Fri, May 15, 2026 at 9:30 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Looping Ben (channel ops) and Irene (channel finance) to run the margin workback and confirm the invoice flow.

Hi all — putting the first-pass workback in the attached spreadsheet (channel_margin_workback.xlsx). High-level notes:

- Method: I mapped each private-offer line to the marketplace SKU, pulled the list price, then applied the private offer discount to arrive at the PO net. From the PO net I allocated the partner passback per our standard reseller tiering.
- Example outcome (sample SKU): list $10,000 -> private-offer price $7,000 (30% discount) -> partner net before tax $2,100 (30% of PO net assigned to partner).
- Holdbacks: we flagged a small 5% early-termination reserve that Redwood typically retains for marketplace-channel reconciliation; that is refundable per normal true-up cadence unless otherwise negotiated.
- Tax: Irene is confirming tax treatment. In some regions we need the reseller EIN to avoid withholding.

Action items where I need BrightLayer help:
- Confirm reseller legal name and tax ID if reseller should be payee.
- Confirm whether BrightLayer expects passback to be net of any platform credits (we treated platform credits as post-discount offsets in the draft).

I’ve also sketched a simple invoice flow diagram (invoice_flow_diagram.png) showing: BrightLayer -> Redwood (private offer settlement) -> Redwood pays reseller (or reseller invoices BrightLayer directly depending on payee setup).

Attaching: channel_margin_workback.xlsx (tab: waterfall), invoice_flow_diagram.png.

Ben Carter
Director, Channel Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@brightlayer.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@brightlayer.com
Date: 2026-05-16T08:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer PO: reconciliation of list-price vs private-offer net

Thanks Ben — that spreadsheet is exactly what the auditor wants to see. A couple quick clarifications so we can close: 

1) Reseller payee: BrightLayer prefers the reseller be the payee. Reseller legal name: "ClearPath Distribution LLC"; tax ID will be provided by EOD 5/17. Please confirm if Redwood needs any additional paperwork to set reseller-as-payee.

2) Holdback: the 5% early-termination reserve is OK as long as it is refundable on the standard 90-day true-up. Please add that language to the attestation PDF.

3) Platform credits: BrightLayer confirms we want passback net of platform credits (credits should reduce the PO net before partner allocation).

Can you update the workbook with those two items and send the attestation PDF for our records? If we get that by 5/19 we can sign off and route to accounting.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Anita
